title: Impossible OS TODO Frontmatter
description: Canonical schema for the YAML frontmatter block carried by every file under todo/**/*.md. Mirrors docs/infrastructure/todo-metadata.md (the human-readable spec). Editors (VS Code YAML extension, Zed YAML, Obsidian YAML-schema plugin) consume this via the per-file $schema field for autocomplete and inline diagnostics. The generator at scripts/todo-graph/build.py implements both this schema and the spec doc; behavior is the union of the two.

$schema.description: Relative path to this JSON Schema file. Programmatic validators (the generator, CI lint, ad-hoc jsonschema calls) follow it. The stock Red Hat YAML language server does NOT auto-detect this as a schema directive in markdown frontmatter; editor-time diagnostics require remark-lint-frontmatter-schema or markdown-yaml-embedded-langservers. Recommended to set even though optional.

schema_version.description: Schema generation. Currently constrained to exactly 1. Bumped only on a NON-additive change (rename, removal, semantic shift); adding a new optional field does NOT bump it. The maximum tracks the current generator + schema together so editors and the generator agree on what is valid (no version-skew split brain).

id.description: Globally unique identifier across all domains. Lowercase kebab-case, 2-60 chars, must start with a letter, must not end with a dash. Stable across renumbering: renaming a TODO file does NOT change its id.

domain.description: Directory short name (folder under todo/). Matches the file's parent directory by convention but is recorded explicitly so the cache schema is self-describing.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Validator gates status: done against every Implementation Order row being [x].

title.description: Human-readable short name. May differ from the H1 heading for length reasons (the H1 is preserved for in-page display).

owners.description: Free-form list of handles, roles, or team names. NOT enforced; advisory.

depends_on.description: Structural dependencies on other TODO ids. The validator builds a digraph from this field and rejects cycles.

satisfies.description: List of ids that this TODO closes when its status flips to done. Powers auto-closure propagation in the validator (gated by full acceptance).

superseded_by.description: Single id. Set when this TODO's status is superseded. Validator surfaces a chain when traversing supersession.

file_patterns.description: Glob patterns marking source paths this TODO owns. Linux MAINTAINERS-style F: parity. Powers the code <id> query (query-CLI section).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. AUTO-DERIVED by the generator from git log --reverse (first-commit timestamp). Do NOT hand-author; the generator overwrites.

last_active_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. AUTO-DERIVED by the generator from git log -1 (last-commit timestamp). Do NOT hand-author; the generator overwrites.
